body:
## GADGET — authorized 48-hour live archival pilot

INSTRUCTION-ID: MSE-LIVE-PILOT-20261121-05 r1. Chad explicitly: “lets install the new build and get the two day live data test running with archival retention. keep backups deferred.” This supersedes -04 source-only/no-install/no-live limits within this bounded pilot. Complete missing live integration and qualify it, safely install in place and activate selected HealthKit records to the dedicated private archive VM. Backups/restores remain DEFERRED. No main merge, public exposure, LLM forwarding, watch development, unrelated VM/IDS changes or committed fixture replay.

Data scope is the 14 selected types from -04: HR, SDNN, resting/walking HR, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, sleeping wrist temperature, steps, walk/run distance, active/basal energy, exercise time, sleep intervals/stages, workout summaries without routes. Prospective pilot: no historical backfill or upload of the preexisting collector database. Use fresh pilot enrollment and type-specific progress, preserve legacy records/anchors. The actual start is set only after verified readiness and explicit launch by PM; end is exactly start+48h, reported in UTC and Guam. Collection and ingestion stop at cutoff; pending unacknowledged bytes remain local, not silently deleted or uploaded outside scope. Archive retention continues without automatic age purge, including original/revision/tombstone/receipt history. Explicit erase is separate. Keep health values and tokens off GitHub, chat, screenshots and ordinary logs; report counts/digests/timing/availability only.

Current signed candidate cf698870 collects all types but has no live endpoint/auth path; current #47 is an offline adapter without a listener. Do not describe installing these alone as live activation. ORACLE must implement actual private HTTPS durable selected sync (safe redirect/TLS behavior, Keychain scoped connection, exact-byte retry/receipt-only dequeue, restart, finite cutoff, stop/status) and preserve data with an additive in-place update. Review actual background HealthKit query/entitlement and network lifecycle for normal locked use; implement what is needed within this pilot but never promise uninterrupted streaming or fill missing samples. No new watch app. NICKY remains sole phone operator; parent may be designated serialized UI proxy. Stage signed build only after independent source/product checks; installation and necessary native permissions/private test trust steps are authorized. Ask Chad only for genuinely required unlock/trust/Health permissions, with exact ready steps.

FORGE supplies minimal versioned live HTTPS adapter, scope/grant/type/record/byte/rate limits, separate fresh selected archive root, pilot start/end enforcement, archival capacity and role-separated reader/export/original access. Preserve existing synthetic archive and receipt4 untouched. No broad migration; private selected store separate from frozen0.2. Publish exact deployable package and prove transport and negative cases synthetically before PHOENIX deploys. Extend schema/export only if needed, with exact source/product compatibility; real-data scope cannot use synthetic fixture digest allowlist. Bound ingestion by explicit enrollment/window and validated records instead. Keep TLS verification mandatory and token access finite.

PHOENIX sole runtime owner: finish already-directed clean reproduction to safe handoff, then deploy reviewed exact live package separately into accepted dedicated archive guest with minimal scoped private ingress. Confirm resource/capacity/readiness, installed source/config/schema identities, service account/file permissions and TLS. Provision necessary fresh scoped keys/grants and private connection; verify CA/leaf/grant/signer lifetimes cover full48h plus staging margin. Existing synthetic leaf expires too early for a new full48h window; do not reuse it blindly. Private configuration and keys stay with custodians. Apply/verify exact-phone network policy before release, no public/SQL listener. Stage sends disabled. Enforce unattended cutoff and document stop/restart/status/operator commands; archive data persists. Do not block pilot on backup work.

SENTINEL independently reviews live transport/auth/window controls, no public route or broad metadata/logging, exact installed runtime/source/private access. Establish actual at-rest protection/access facts without claiming anonymity or duplicating separate IDS work. NICKY independently tests code then preserves collector/outbox opaquely, verifies signer/phone, installs in place, imports connection and coordinates native permissions; no real payload before readiness GO. PROVENANCE binds signed app/package/schema/config/destination and actual initial live receipt/original/view/export with private custody, using counts/digests rather than values. ATLAS pins pilot window, type/availability/revision/current/history/export contract and exact reproducible configuration. LONESTAR tracks staging vs installed vs authorized-start vs actual firstcommit vs running/cutoff and owning acknowledgements. GADGET sequences all gates and sets actual start/cutoff after readiness, then verifies first live commit and stable followup before reporting running.

Acceptance before reporting RUNNING: independently qualified deployed live endpoint and signed client; in-place collector preservation; selected permission/availability readback; actual first real selected batch acknowledged and exactly reopened from selected store, scoped view/export matched; queue/retry/last-ack status visible without health values; same configured start/end on phone/server, stop and archival retention verified. Daily baseline is descriptive coverage/lag/gaps/counts and device impact, not clinical diagnosis. No external automation is inferred; runtime expiry is part of pilot implementation. A 48-hour run cannot be claimed complete at launch. Report genuine blockers and exact user-only actions promptly, continue all independent preparation.
